content: Node streams implement Symbol.asyncIterator (stable since Node 11.14; fs.ReadStream + node:readline createInterface yields one line at a time with crlfDelay:Infinity = constant memory). The SAME parsing core can run in the browser by depending only on an AsyncIterable<string> 'line source' port: the Node adapter wraps readline over fs.ReadStream; the browser adapter wraps a File via fetch(file).body.pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream()) and splits on newlines. Isomorphic line-reader packages (readlineiter/fetchline) prove this shape works cross-platform. Thus the parser core stays pure and platform-agnostic.
